_comment: <project>/.harness/config.json — what this project IS. Overrides user config per key. Written by /harness:init; safe to edit by hand.

repos.name: app
repos._path_note: relative to the project root (the dir containing .harness/); '.' if the project root is itself the repo

tickets._source_options: github (labeled issues on tickets.repo — the default when a GitHub repo exists) | local (.harness/tickets/*.md — zero-dependency floor for folders without a queue repo)

_workflow_options: gsd (drive GSD headlessly with --auto entry points) | generic

parallel._note: upper bound on concurrent worker sessions; the rate gate can hold new spawns below this

guardrails._never_push_note: true = integration stays local; the run ends at PR-ready branches + a report. Set false only when you want the harness opening PRs itself.
owner_gated: anything requiring a secret only the owner holds
guardrails._owner_gated_note: always owner-gated, regardless of any other setting or override — the orchestrator writes these to OWNER-ACTIONS.md instead of doing them

models._note: optional per-project overrides of the user-level chains, same syntax
